summary: Feature implemented in rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ReaderContext, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file), with new tests in tests/test_progress.py, docs subsections in docs/source/progress.rst, and a CHANGELOG.md entry under Unreleased/Added. Nothing committed. Tests, mypy, and black were not run, per the instructions; the code was verified by reading only. Open risks: the four type-ignore suppressions may trigger unused-ignore errors under strict mypy; mode and name properties were added to avoid abstract-class instantiation failure; the 'tr' mode returns bytes per spec.
